name: Rob Nosse
occupation: State Representative; labor representative (Oregon Nurses Association)

bio.statement: Nosse's official page says he represents voters in southeast and northeast Portland.
bio.excerpt: I'm proud to represent the voters of SE and NE Portland

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Nosse member page

bio.statement: Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes working as a labor representative for the Oregon Nurses Association since 2004.
bio.excerpt: His professional experience includes working as a labor representative for the Oregon Nurses Association since 2004.

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Nosse's occupation as State Representative, with a background as a labor representative for the Oregon Nurses Association, SEIU staff director and organizer, and Oregon Student Association executive director.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative Occupational Background: Labor Representative, Oregon Nurses Association; Staff Director and organizer at SEIU; Executive Director, Oregon Student Association

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Miami University, Oxford, Ohio (B.A.) as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Miami University, Oxford, Ohio; B.A

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists the Public Employee Benefits Board as his prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Public Employee Benefits Board

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says in his pamphlet statement that he championed, and will keep advocating for, more funding for mental health, addiction treatment and homeless services.
positions.excerpt: Advocate for more mental health, addiction, and homeless services.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse lists making it easier to build more housing and apartments among the things he has championed.
positions.excerpt: Making it easier to build more housing and apartments.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse lists Paid Family and Medical Leave among the things he has championed.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse lists a corporate activities tax to better fund schools among the things he has championed.
positions.excerpt: A corporate activities tax to better fund schools.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says he will demand better K-12 funding, with no more layoffs in Portland Public Schools.
positions.excerpt: Demand better funding for K – 12 education -- No more layoffs in PPS.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says he will demand better funding for universities and community colleges to reduce tuition and student debt.
positions.excerpt: Demand better funding for universities and community colleges so we can reduce tuition and lower student debt.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says in his pamphlet statement that he will work toward a universal healthcare system so everyone has affordable medical and mental healthcare.
positions.excerpt: Work toward a universal healthcare system so that everyone can have affordable medical and mental healthcare.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says he supports Planned Parenthood and will stand up for legal, safe, affordable reproductive healthcare including abortion.
positions.excerpt: Always stand up for legal, safe, and affordable reproductive healthcare including abortion.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse says he will push for more action on climate change, particularly in transportation, and wants a transportation package passed.
positions.excerpt: Push for more action on climate change particularly when it comes to transportation. We have to get a transportation package passed.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Nosse lists adequate funding for road and bridge maintenance and transit among the things he has championed.
positions.excerpt: Adequate funding for road and bridge maintenance and transit.
